issues.feedback: Requirement #1 is incomplete for tmux mode. `TmuxBackend::build_shell_command` currently only uses `effective_args()` when `session_id` is present, so fresh tmux invocations bypass `ensure_json_output_args` entirely. Add an explicit tmux-path change so fresh Claude calls also get exactly one `--output-format stream-json`.

issues.area: Edge Case (Claude stream session id source)
issues.feedback: The spec says extract session id from `message_start`, but the proposed field `message.id` may be a message id, not the resume session id used by `--resume`. Define exact field precedence based on real stream payloads (e.g., top-level `session_id`, `message.session_id`, etc.) to avoid breaking session reuse.

Detection rules are inconsistent (`any parsed line has type` vs `first valid JSON line has type`) and too broad. A single-object JSON containing a top-level `type` could be misrouted. Define a deterministic rule using known Claude stream event types (allowlist) and clearly state first-line vs any-line behavior.

There is a contract conflict: the spec says `normalize_output` should return `Err(ParseError)` when events parse but no assistant text, but also says it must return a valid `NormalizedOutput` so retry logic is unchanged. Clarify whether the strict guarantee applies to `normalize_output` itself or to orchestrator-level `normalize_backend_output` fallback behavior.

Conformance test #13 has contradictory timing: emitting, then sleeping longer than timeout, cannot 'complete successfully'. Redesign to emit periodic heartbeats at intervals strictly less than `timeout_seconds` and assert no timeout.

Acceptance criteria require tmux inactivity semantics, but the test plan does not include explicit tmux heartbeat tests. Add tests for: stdout growth resets idle timer, stderr-only growth resets idle timer, and no growth triggers timeout. Also test that stderr capture is persisted in artifacts.

The spec requires warn logs on kill with backend/role/attempt/idle/elapsed, but low-level kill points do not naturally have attempt context. Define a single canonical logging point and data source for all required fields (especially `attempt`) to prevent partial/duplicated logging.

The Codex conformance test should explicitly force execution through Codex (e.g., set `workflow.planner_backend=codex`) so it actually validates shared inactivity-timeout behavior rather than default Claude paths.
